description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories within the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2. The pie chart is divided into six slices, representing different categories. The categories are: Moroccan Names (orange), which occupies approximately 16% of the chart; Semantic Categories (purple), which is very small, around 0%; Syntactic Roles (brown), making up about 16%; Translated Sentences (yellow), which is the largest slice at around 32%; Extra + Augmented Data (blue), taking up about 21%; and Pending Translations (green), occupying around 30%. The chart includes a legend that corresponds to the colors used for each category, and some slices have numerical labels indicating their quantities. The slices are not ordered in a particular way, and no slice is visually emphasized.
